batting.dismissal: c MEK Hussey b MM Sharma

batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b JA Morkel

batting.name: IK Pathan
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b RA Jadeja

batting.name: AB Agarkar
batting.dismissal: c DJ Bravo b R Ashwin

batting.name: UT Yadav
batting.dismissal: c SK Raina b DJ Bravo

balls.text: slower one and he's run-out this time last ball. it was hit away to the leg side but not off the middle, wanted to get back for the second but he's not quick enough to get back
another slower one and this time gets the bat on it, pulled away to the deep region, gets a single and then a misfield allows him to come back for the second
down the leg side and it's a wide this, was a slower one and he was on his back foot, wanted to flick it away but missed
on his pads and he looks to pull it away, gets hit on his pads, just for a single to the leg side

gone, caught at deep square-leg and that ends an excellent innings! he was looking to slog it away and does not hit the middle of the bat here, gets it straight to the fielder there who runs around to catch it
and this is a dot this time, was looking to go over the bowler's head but the short of length delivery beats him this time

a very full ball and he unleashes the Helicopter! He saw that the fielder was at long-on, straighter than normal and he flicks it with a lot of power to the right of the fielder, Warner, who dives but to no avail
wants to smash it over mid-wicket but plays the shot early, the ball runs over to mid-wicket for a single
and this time he gets that four over the bowler's head, was a full-toss and he whips it over for a four, was a low full-toss too so a good shot in the end!
wide this time, on the off side, and did I spot some swing away from the bat, one way or the other it's very wide
full-toss and he swings his bat away, Dhoni thinks he has hit it well enough to get it to the fence but Mendis fields very well at long-on, restricts him to two
a very slow ball and he was looking to slog it away but does not get it off the middle of the bat, to the fielder
again looks to slog it away but gets an inside edge that goes to the square-leg fielder who has a shy at Dhonis end, misses
inside edge and it bounces and rolls over to the keeper, he was looking to hit it hard but it did not even arrive
and this is an excellent shot, full-toss again with Hussey on strike and he calmly plays it over the bowler's head and for a four
not a good ball, full-toss, outside the off and Hussey just needed an outside edge to get it to the fence, into the 60s now
wide outside the off stump but not wide enough, it was a full-toss and Hussey does not get close enough to it
shortens his length this time and Dhoni pulls out of a 'smash' and instead pushes it to the off side for a single
and he's gone leg side and it bounces once and goes to the fence for a four! what a shot, slogged away to the deep square-leg region for a four
very full and very straight and that's muscled over the boundary for a six! It's Dhoni time this...
and what a shot to round off what's been a good over! it was fuller from the bowler and he goes down the ground, straight back and over his head for a four
wider from Pathan, on a good length too and Dhoni drives it to long-off for a single
full from Pathan and slogged away to deep mid-wicket for a single
again not too quick and Dhoni was shaping up to play it over mid-wicket from the back foot, he does not get too much bat on it, rolls over to long-on
fuller and driven down the ground for a single to long-on
outside the off stump and he wants to crash it through the covers, this is not as quick as the previous over and he looks to have played his shot early

Dropped at long-off! unleashes a hard stroke there Dhoni and it's dropped by Ajit Agarkar at long-off! it was full and he wanted to go over the fielder but does not get any elevation, goes flat at him
very full from Yadav and pushed to the off side for a single to bring up his 50, good dependable batting and I continue to wonder why was he dropped last game
and now he cracks it through the covers for a single, it was a very full ball but straight to the fielder
full, fast and on his pads, tries to crack it over the leg side but does not get too much power on it, which is also why they are able to get back for the second
a slower one that does not bounce, he is able to pat it to the leg side where the bowler has to rush across and field
immediately down the pitch and wants to cut it away, misses it, was looking to get it through the point region there
on his pads from round from Nadeem and he wants to sweep, gets hit on his pads, bit of a frivolous appeal from the bowler
fuller from the bowler and that's the arc he loves, the slog over deep mid-wicket and gone all the way for a six!
shorter from Nadeem this time and MSD has pushed it down to long-on for a single
fuller from Nadeem, he makes it into a full-toss and taps it long-on for a single
goes down the track and wants to smash it over the deep square-leg, but gets an inside edge for a single
short of length and Dhoni tucks it off the back foot and immediately after the ball touches the bat, he calls two! Gets it two, they were haring across
flicked away over the in field to the leg side for a single
and it's hit hard and strong and despite no room to play that shot, it's still gone over the in-field for a four!
fuller on his pads and flicked away to deep square-leg for a single
very full from Morne and that's flicked away to the deep square-leg for a couple of runs
tucked away to the leg side for a single

whoa, almost a run-out! it was a fuller ball and dug out by Hussey, he was always interested in the single, Dhoni wasn't sure but he had to go for it, Warner throws it at Dhoni's end but it hits him and not the stumps. Warner wasn't happy but Dhoni wasn't changing his direction
short from Pathan and guess what, Dhoni's spanked it over mid-wicket for a four! It's as hard a shot as you would see from the captain and it gets the result he wants, a four!
edged and gone! Raina's walking to a caught behind! It was outside the off and Raina was looking to clear his foot and smack it over the off side, gets only an outside edge and taken by the keeper

tucked away to the leg side and they complete a single, he comes back for the second and the throw is a little far from the keeper, who whips the bails but by then he's in, third ump into action and he's got an easy decision to make
a very slow, slower ball, 120 km/hr and Raina was trying to cut it away, gets a bit of under edge to the keeper
pulled away to the fence, it was shorter in length and Raina goes for that shot and to backward square-leg for a four
slower ball, outside the off stump, cut away to the deep point region for a single
slower one and on a length, easily tapped to square-leg for a single
outside the off stump and drilled away through the covers for a four! Was a very full ball from Agarkar and it was slashed away to the fence
powerful punch off the back foot from Raina, but straight to long-on for a single
shorter and slower as well and Hussey tucks it away to the leg side for a single
finally gets hold of a shot Hussey, he looked to be getting into his shell but this time he pulls it over mid-wicket and for a six, too short that
slower bouncer, takes the pace off it and Raina was looking to pull it away, but not off the middle of the bat to fine-leg
pushed to the off side and not for runs, better over for CSK
slower one but on the middle stump, beats the bat and hits the pads, was going down the leg side, bit of an appeal there but not-out
and now he pitches it short, Raina wants to pull it away but straight to square-leg who is inside the circle
and again and this is even better, almost goes for a six, it's fuller and he smashes it and does it with a lot of grace too
up and over and for a four! Raina finally gets some width to free his arms, does exactly that and gets it over extra cover for a boundary, was a slower one
opens his stance up a little and pushed to the off side for no run
slower one from Agarkar and he's only able to tap it to the covers for another dot
short of length this and allows Raina to pull it away to the deep square-leg region for a single
shimmy down the pitch and manages to only defend it away on the off side, desperate single attempted and needed a direct hit from Mendis to run Raina out
that's a good delivery, he's managing to keep Hussey away from that cut shot, getting the ball back and cramping him for room
swing back into the batsman to tuck him a little, Raina was looking to swing his bat away but gets it on his pads and it rolls over to the leg side
slower one, outside the off stump and Hussey guides it through the backward point region for a single
he stopped in his run-up there, Raina was almost waiting on his back foot and in the end manages to get his bat down in time
faster, on the middle and pushed away to deep square-leg for a single
flatter and this is straighter, does not turn back into the batsman who is down the track and pushes it to long-on
swept away to fine-leg region for a couple of runs, Pathan does well to slide around the restrict it to couple
shorter from the bowler, on the back foot and pushed to the mid-on region
on a length from round the stumps, nurdles it round the corner for a single
very short and that was way, way down the leg side, he was looking to sweep it away and there was a huge appeal for caught behind, given wide
and now a swish outside the off stump, nowhere close to the ball, beats the inside edge
whoa, almost gets the leg-stump, he was looking to paddle Agarkar away by moving slightly towards the off stump, played that shot too early I thought
fuller from Agarkar and Raina gets his bat and pad out and taps into the covers
and fuller this time, Raina's quick to get on to his front foot and defends it back to the bowler, Agarkar dives to his left to field
and some more movement back into the batsman, interestingly it's from length and not very full, defended on the back foot
this time he gets his line right, on the middle and swinging back into the left-hander, defended on the front foot to the off side and off for a single
and starts with a wide, but the good news for him is that there was some swing on that one. Short of length and it was swinging down the leg side
and a four this time, it was a mere chip over the bowler's head and it's gone all the way to the fence, good shot to end what was turning out to be a decent over from Sehwag
again on his pads in a bid to cramp him, tucks it to square-leg for a single
room to cut it and Raina does it easily, gets it to the sweeper region
shortish, quickish on his pads, and flicked away to the short fine-leg fielder for a single
very short from Sehwag and easily nudged away to deep square-leg for a single
shortish from round the stumps, goes back and pushes it through mid-wicket for a single
on a good length and the batsman is again on his back foot, tapped away to the off side, good end to the over
slightly fuller from Raina, he was looking to unleash his drive but managed to restrain himself, again into the covers
another one that's in that good length area and Raina wants to defend again, is able to play it away to the cover fielder
short of length, he's quickly on the back foot and defends it in front of him, over to the off side
swing away from the bowler and opens the face of the bat, guides it down to the third-man region for a four
width from Pathan and exquisitely played from Hussey, bit of bent feet and driven through the covers for a four
tucked away to the leg side but straight to the fielder
shorter in length and almost a run-out! Raina plays it from the back foot and does not want a run, Hussey does and is almost halfway down, direct hit was needed from Nadeem, but doesn't hit
and wow, just wow! It is full, mind you, its the first ball he's facing tonight and Raina's has driven it like how mist graceful left-handers would, races away!

gone, lbw, was very full too! this was good length, not too full, not too short, and to add to Vijay's woes, there was in-swing back into the batsman; beaten and hits the pads. Loud, loud appeal followed and after a lot of thought, it was given. Vijay looks unhappy.
short of length and that's a mere push which is gone away, just sped away, it beat the in-field and gained speed after that to the fence!
short of length and cramping him for room, taps it to the leg side and they are off for a quick single
whoa, what a shot! short of length for a change and Vijay's smacked it over the mid-wicket region for a four, that was hammered!
and again, he's come out with the intention of bowling very full and this one did swing back into the left-hander, gets his bat on it to fine-leg for a single
outside the off stump and tapped to the extra-cover region
wide outside the off and up to the bat, he goes for a drive but manages to slice it to the third-man fielder, Ajit Agarkar gets his hands to it
it's full again but a touch wider and Vijay hits it back to the bowler, lost his hand over the bat too
superb! it was very full, swinging away slightly but Vijay went after it, drives it through the covers and for four!
and for a change he goes after it, is able to glide it away through backward point for a couple of runs, well fielded by Yadav
and another one left alone, seeing out what is a good spell this from Morkel
and again, left alone, shoulder arms by watching it the last moment and collected by the keeper
outside the off stump and left alone by the batsman, lot of bounce there for Morkel
down the leg side and that's a wide, swing back into the left-hander there
short of length again but this time it's on his body, tucked away neatly by the batsman to the leg side
short of length and outside the off stump, left alone by the batsman
bowls length outside off and gets generous swing away from the left hander, Hussey leaves it alone
short of length delivery outside off, he goes on the back foot and punches it to cover
worked away through midwicket
worked away on the leg side for an easy single
driven hard, but straight to point
worked down to third man for a brace

hits it straight to the fielder at long-on to end what has been a depressing innings to watch. it was fuller, was slower too and he tries to repeat what his top-order did, hit over the fielder but much like the top-order, the ball goes straight to the fielder
very full this time but the flick shot does not come off from Yadav, gets hit on his pads
slower one from round the stumps and that's defended off the back foot, back to the bowler
fullish from the bowler and he can only drive it to mid-off
was looking to move around in the crease and get it over short fine-leg, Morkel saw that and changed the pace well, hits his pads
it is on a length and on the off stump, he punches it on the rise but it does not go away too far
length ball this time and it's pushed to the off side, they rush across for a quick single too
full from Morkel and on the off stump, Yadav pats it to the off side
short, wide and cut hard, but tell you what, it's been cut straight to the fielder there at point and Bravo takes a very simple catch
was going back to cut it but gets nowhere close to doing that
fullish again and driven to the off side where the short cover fielder runs across to field
fuller and was that a drop? he tries to drill it through the covers but the outside edge edge flies to the right of the slip fielder Raina, gets some hand on it but it's too quick for him
shorter from Ashwin and tapped to the off side by Nadeem
bowled him, was looking to hoick it away but misses, that has taken timber along its way, end of the eighth wicket
slower and shorter, wanted to cut it away, gets it to the off side
tries to cut it away, gets bit of an edge and it rolls away to the short third-man
flatter, fuller and on the leg stump, tapped away to the deep square-leg for a single
played away to the leg side for a single there, goes to mid-wicket
on the front foot and defended it back to the bowler
quicker, flatter and for a change he's able to cut it away hard enough to beat the in-field and for a four! that run-out aside he's done well agan
pushed down the ground for a single to get off the mark
on the pads and he was trying to tap it to the leg side, gets hit on the pads but it's going down
and now he's gone, caught by Bravo again! fuller from Ashwin, gets it quite close to the ball and the shot over the in-field goes straight to the fielder at long-on, easily taken
tries to give it fair thwack there but the ball does not quite arrive, on the bounce to the fielder
fuller from Ashwin and drilled down to mid-wicket for a single
cuts it away to the off side for a single
shorter, offie, quicker too and he was trying to pull it away, misses
fuliish there and tapped gently down the ground for a single
very short from Jadeja, turns away as well, cut away to deep point for a single
shorter this time, anticipating him to come down again but he pulls it from his back foot and gets a run
fuller from Jadeja and Agarkar drives it down, back to the bowler

down the track and caught! he was looking to hit it with the spin, get it over long-on, but does not get it from the middle of the bat, caught very easily by Bravo, who does his little jig after holding on to that
short of length and cut away to the off side, fielded well by Ashwin
skips down the pitch this time and hits it over to mid-wicket for a single
fuller then from Ashwin, almost yorks the batsman, who digs it back to the bowler
very short from Ashwin this time and he is looking to pull it away, the pace seems to have died down and the shot trickles away to the leg side
fullish from Ashwin and flicks it to the leg side for a single
fuller from the bowler and Pathan's on the front foot, tapped gently to the leg side for a single
fuller and on the middle, driven down to the leg side for a single
quicker, flatter and a bit of turn for him, hits him on his pads, Jadeja is the only one appealing
he was trying to play a funny little slog there but misses it quite comfortably there
on his pads and flicked away to the leg side for a single
shorter and cut away to the deep point for a single

gone, run-out, what a way to get out!  shorter this time and he's able to flick it away to the deep region, Jadhav is very slow and does not want the second, Mendis wants it all the time and he is halfway through back when he realises that the partner's responding, wants to get back but he slips, and is easily run-out!
quicker on his pads and flicked it away to the leg side, taps it gently actually and gets back for the second one too
a boundary to round things off, was very short from Ashwin and he's able to rock back and pull it over the mid-wicket area for a four!
slower from Ashwin and he was very early into his sweep, is still able to get it away to the leg side for a run
shorter one and cut away to the deep point region for a single
swept away to the fine-leg and it's fielded well there, rolls over and throws the ball back to the other fielder running across
straighter one and he looks to open his bat but gets it down to short third-man
round the stumps, gets his pad out and sweeps it down to square-leg for a singe
goes down the track and very casually flicks it away to the leg side, they run hard and come back for the second
played away to the leg side and this time he gets a single
shorter and wants to pull it away, but it's a tad slower too so nothing on the bat
opens the face of the bat and it's rolled over to fine third-man, Ashwin moves around quickly and fields well
shorter in length this time and it's flicked away to the leg side for a single
fuller on the middle and driven through mid-wicket for a single
slower one from the bowler and turns it down to fine-leg for a single

on a length and on the off stump and that's one of the shots of the game, he just pushed it to the leg side and at one stage it looked it would be a couple...not too long after that, it rolled over the fence!
outside the off and he's cut it away to the third-man region for a single
goes down the pitch and wants to smash it back, gets it very low on his bat and it's athletically fielded by Bravo
short of length, slower and was trying to cut it through the in-field, gets a hand at point that slows it down en route to third-man
short of length from round the stumps and he was looking to pull it away, gets bit of a glove down to fine-leg for a single
flicked away, was on the middle and fuller and gets it away to deep square-leg for a run
very close to the stumps, on the off and he is only able to tap it away to the point region
on a length on the off stump and he pats it away to the off side for a single
slower ball from Morkel and it's paddled away to fine-leg by Mendis for a single
short of length and he looks to open the face of the bat to get it to third-man, fielded at point
very full from Morkel and dug it out to Jadeja at the point region
almost a catch! he was looking to pull it away but falls just short of the mid-wicket fielder there and they are able to go through for a single
outside the off stump from round the stumps and he shoulders arms, lets it go through to the keeper
a very slow ball, 105.2 km/hr and he was looking to smack it away but needed to control it in the end, played it away to third-man for a single
another one on the off stump line and defended well to the off side, in other news the required rate's almost crept up to 10
on a good length and he is looking to defend it on the front foot, not for runs

short of length and Sehwag's holed out! it was a ball to play that shot but he does not play that too well, hits it high on the bat and it's gone and straight into the hands of the deep square-leg fielder there, four down for barely anything
and now he's given out, lbw! he was trying to flick it over the leg side but misses it and it raps him in front, the umpire raise his finger this time and the captain's not too happy there!
and now he defends it on the off side, not for a run
whoa, that's a big appeal for a caught behind from both the bowler and the wicket-keeper, there seemed to be a bit of a nick there but cannot be sure. The ump says not-out
short of length and swivelled away while pulling it to long-leg for a four! they needed that to get going!
good bounce and he was trying to open the face of the bat through to the third-man region, misses the outside edge
short of length from Morris and its at decent pace, MJ taps it to the off side, Sehwag doesn't want a quick single there
driven back to the bowler, Mohit was looking to field it but isn't able to get down and its fielder by mid-off
short of length but again not too much pace, Sehwag was looking to play the upper cut but the lack of pace does not allow Sehwag to play that too well, falls just short of the third-man fielder
fuller and this is slightly within the stumps, flicks it away to wide mid-on for a single
and a bouncer, wide called but some effort from someone who does not look very threatening, it goes way over his head
not that he's bowling very quick but it's a slower one here, 111/9 km/hr, pushes it to the off side and to the fielder
131 km/hr on the off stump, tapped to the off side but again does not pierce the field and it's a dot
fuller on the off stump line and that's very well defended to the off side
not too well-timed but enough to get him a four, he was trying to hit it over the mid-on fielder but gets it over mid-wicket, the results counts in the end!
and was looking to play that shot that earned him the six, misses and it hit on his pads, was way down the leg side
and another inside edge there, for a couple of runs to the leg side, he was looking to drive it through the covers but gets it away to fine-leg
flicked away to the leg side for a couple of runs, that's much better from Sehwag there
short of length yet again, and but inside edged it, not getting the timing there
wow, what a bouncer, Sehwag was looking to duck but it went too quickly there
down the leg side and another wide, attempting to cramp him for room there

gone, given, lbw! that's wicket number two for Mohit, and it's Juneja's turn this time, it was jagging back into the bat, hits his pads and the umpire, after some thought gives it out, looked like it was a tad high and going down
short of length outside the off stump and Juneja has been able to punch it through the covers, there was a bit of a hand there from one of the fielders in the covers, gets a couple of runs
short of length and defended stoutly to the off side, not for a run through
bowled him, inside edge and that's sent the stumps down! it was shorter in length and Warner wanted to cut it away, gets it very low on his bat and the inside edge sends the timber down
short of length and tapped to the off side, fielded at the covers, or should have fielded but a bit of a misfield allows them a run
this time he gets it right at 130.4 km/hr, on the off stump, marginal swing away and defended to the off side
not a good start there from Mohit Shrma, it was down the leg side and Sehwag wanted to flick it at first, wouldn't have got any close to the ball anyway!
short of length immediately, gets an inside edge and it rolls over to the leg side for a single, Taufel in the comms box picks that inside edge immediately
and wow, that's a free swing on the leg side, goes all the way for the six! it was fuller on his pads and Sehwag gets it right off the middle of the bat to get him the maximum
fullish from Morkel, Sehwag drives it down to the mid-on, Bravo's there to field it
down the leg side and a wide, it was short of a length and he looks to flick it away but gets no bat on it
fuller on the off stump and driven through the covers for a single, bit of a misfield I think
what a delivery, it was shorter in length and for some time it just didn't arrive, the lack of pace and the extra bounce had Warner fending it off, falls short of the square-leg fielder
fuller on the off stump, driven to the extra-cover but to the fielder
